svg.title: Kerosene control state reference
svg.desc: Proposed button, selection, and input states in a dark and light palette. Focus rings and stable bounds are design targets, not a claim of existing keyboard support.
svg.text: Stable labels and geometry · selection persists through hover · focus is a separate indicator · synthetic examples
SELECTION / mode choices retain their indicator
FIELDS / 28px frame · visible label · unit slot
Busy retains action context. Disabled controls do not activate.
Focus support requires native widget/state work where missing.
